detection.message: Resizing or compression changed the model's result. Use the original score with caution; small copies can lose important detail.
detection.method: Three 528-pixel crops per version; average crop logits, then sigmoid.
detection.scope: AI-generated images; not face swaps, video, or audio

evidence.title: An experimental model ran, but cannot verify this image
evidence.description: The model examined the image’s pixels. Its output has not been calibrated or independently validated for this app, so even a near-zero or near-100 score does not support a real/fake conclusion. File details do not change this output.
evidence.observed: Raw AI-class output: 0.955733 (0–1 scale; not a confidence estimate)

evidence.title: Three parts of the original were checked
evidence.description: The model checked the start, middle, and end of the image's longer side, using overlapping square crops. Their outputs were combined into the original-image score. These are classification scores, not locations of proven edits.

evidence.title: Resizing or compression changed the result
evidence.description: Original: 95.57/100; JPEG copy: 89.12/100; Smaller copy: 5.93/100. The range was 89.64 points. The preferred class changed or the score moved by at least 60 points. The smaller copy is only 128 × 128 pixels and can lose useful detail. This sensitivity reduces how much we can rely on the result.

evidence.title: No specific visual defect was established
evidence.description: This classifier returns a score, not a description or location of an edit. It has not identified mismatched eyes, skin, lighting, or a swapped face. The file checks below are separate observations, not an explanation of the model’s internal decision.

evidence.title: Face swaps were not tested
evidence.description: There is no face-manipulation detector in this build. An AI-generation score cannot rule out a swapped or edited face. This remains an untested part of the image.

evidence.title: Brightness variation
evidence.description: Highest measurement: row 1, column 1 (254.78 levels); typical region: 88.58 levels. The regional range is 208.43 levels. Brightness is affected by object colors, shadows, and exposure. This does not estimate light-source direction or establish physically inconsistent lighting.

evidence.title: Texture variation
evidence.description: Highest measurement: row 4, column 2 (4.67 bits); typical region: 4.09 bits. The regional range is 4.67 bits. Natural materials, hair, text, blur, and noise all change entropy. High or low entropy alone does not indicate synthesis or an edit.

evidence.title: Fine-detail / noise residual
evidence.description: Highest measurement: row 3, column 3 (16.45 levels RMS); typical region: 11.63 levels RMS. The regional range is 16.13 levels RMS. This mixes texture, edges, sharpening, and noise. It is not a sensor-noise estimate or a camera fingerprint; differences need contextual review.

evidence.title: JPEG re-save difference
evidence.description: Highest measurement: row 2, column 5 (2.88 levels); typical region: 2.23 levels. The regional range is 2.68 levels. Detailed edges and saturated colors often change most. This is a controlled re-save experiment, not proof of a pasted region or a reconstruction of past compression.

evidence.title: Evidence identity established
evidence.description: A SHA-256 digest was calculated so this exact file can be referenced and compared later.

evidence.title: Near-random byte distribution
evidence.description: The file has unusually high byte entropy, which may indicate encryption, packing, or a mislabeled container.

evidence.title: Sparse origin metadata
evidence.description: No camera or software origin fields were found. Many platforms strip this data, so this is weak evidence.

evidence.title: No provenance manifest detected
evidence.description: No C2PA-style marker was found in the scanned container. Absence is not evidence of manipulation.

notes: Resizing or compression changed the model's result. Use the original score with caution; small copies can lose important detail.
This model checks AI-generated still images, not face swaps or other localized edits.
Smaug combines three image crops for each score. Scores are uncalibrated; unseen generators, screenshots, and compression may cause errors.
Our local checks found errors on heavily downsized copies. Resizing agreement is a robustness check, not an accuracy measurement.
No deployment accuracy has been established. Automatic authenticity verdicts are disabled; raw model output is diagnostic only.
